title: Escalation: Missing Environment Variable 'LEDGER_REGION'
body: The test 'test_ledger_region_required' in 'tests/test_ledger.py' consistently fails with a KeyError: 'LEDGER_REGION' across 3 reruns. The CI environment is missing the required environment variable, which is critical for the test to pass. This is classified as an 'env' issue due to the missing variable. No automated patch was applied because environment drift cannot be safely fixed without masking potential deployment gaps. Please verify that the 'LEDGER_REGION' variable is correctly set in the CI configuration and ensure it is propagated to all relevant environments.
